messages:
sam-platform: Proposal: map 'Pro' plan to per-org monthly quota 50M tokens, per-key burst window 10k tokens / 1s with token-bucket refill. Need alignment on billing and console UX. Thoughts?

maria-dev: +1 on 50M baseline, but we should make burst limits configurable per key for clients that do heavy batching.

lee-sre: Concern: 10k/s burst is high if many keys share a single org pool. We should enforce per-key and per-org enforcement tiers separately. Suggest per-key burst 5k/s, org-wide concurrent token drain check.

sam-platform: Good point. What if we do: per-key instantaneous burst = 5k, sustained per-key = 1k/s avg over 60s, org softcap = 50M/month with auto-throttle at 85%?

aisha-pm: UX: Console should show current month usage, projected spend if usage continues, and a clear banner when a key is in burst-throttle. Also an API endpoint to fetch key quota state for client-side backoff logic.

maria-dev: For enforcement path, we can implement a hybrid: local token-bucket at edge (fast), authoritative counters in redis shards (for billing/analytics). Edge returns 429 with headers: 

```
X-Quota-Remaining: 4123
X-Quota-Limit: 5000
X-Quota-Reset: 1670000000
```
and a body code `quota_throttle`. That keeps client controls simple.

lee-sre: Agree on headers. Also record a telemetry event `quota.enforcement.action` with fields: org_id, key_id, action, reason, approximate_remaining, enforcement_tier. We can sample 1% to avoid overload.

sam-platform: How should billing map to tiers? Free: 1M/month + 100 req/min burst. Pro: 50M/month + configured burst. Enterprise: custom + dedicated capacity option. We need the mapping documented for sales and console.

aisha-pm: Sales need a clean matrix: plan -> monthly tokens -> per-key burst default -> enforcement behavior (soft throttle, hard throttle) -> SLA. I'll compile a one-pager after we land defaults.

maria-dev: Implementation notes: router will check key-local bucket then org global bucket. If local allows but org denies, return `429` with reason `org_quota_exhausted` and header `X-Org-Quota-Remaining: 0`. Add a `retry-after` that is conservative (seconds).

lee-sre: Also add an emergency bypass flag for enterprise keys tied to billing/resolution flow so we can temporarily lift hard throttles for incident mitigation. Audit log mandatory.

sam-platform: Rollout plan: feature-flag the enforcement in prod for 10% of traffic for 2 weeks, capture telemetry, check false positives. Quota-bot to notify #incidents on any large-scale throttles.

quota-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag rollout start 1745002000. Telemetry sampling: 1%. Alerts: >0.5% of keys hitting hard-throttle in 1h.

aisha-pm: ok. action items: Maria to draft enforcement API spec, Lee to add telemetry schema, Sam to update pricing matrix, I'll do console mockups. Deadline EOW. :thumbsup:
